$description: CSS-native values that DTCG cannot express exactly (shadow stacks, gradients, em letter-spacing, keyword easing, rgba glass, keyword sizes). They are emitted verbatim into the CSS outputs and resolved into dist/tokens.json. "root" belongs to Yggdrasil Dark (default); "shell" overrides it for Yggdrasil Light "Shell". surface-* tokens express layout material per theme so components never branch on the theme.

surface-frame-gap.$description: gap between panels; the page shows through

surface-panel-filter.$description: backdrop filter on panels; frost when the sheet is translucent

surface-reading.$description: note body and source editor reading surface

material-glitch.$description: Shell night-city tear layer; Dark has none

city-dip-animation.$description: animation name for .fx-city; none keeps Dark static

city-fade-2-animation.$description: animation name for .fx-city layers; none keeps Dark static

city-fade-3-animation.$description: animation name for .fx-city layers; none keeps Dark static

city-glitch-animation.$description: animation name for .fx-city layers; none keeps Dark static
